tasks.title: Run baseline Lighthouse audits on key pages
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse audits in Chrome DevTools on homepage (/), /templates, a template detail page, /rep/[bioguideId], and a ZIP results page. Record Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO scores in the Baseline Scores table in docs/tasks/lighthouse-optimization.md.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline scores recorded for all 5 pages (homepage, templates index, template detail, rep profile, ZIP results)
Each page has scores for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO
Scores table in docs/tasks/lighthouse-optimization.md is filled in

tasks.title: Fix critical accessibility issues
tasks.description: Review Lighthouse audit results and fix all accessibility issues causing scores below 90. Common issues include color contrast, missing alt text, missing form labels, and focus indicators. Also verify og-default.png is under 100KB and add lazy loading to rep photos if missing.
acceptance_criteria: All color contrast issues resolved (WCAG AA minimum)
All images have appropriate alt text
All form inputs have associated labels
Focus indicators visible on interactive elements
og-default.png is optimized (under 100KB)
Rep photos use lazy loading attribute

tasks.title: Fix critical performance issues
tasks.description: Address render-blocking resources, large bundle sizes, and other performance issues identified in the Lighthouse audit. Focus on eliminating render-blocking CSS/JS, ensuring proper font loading, and verifying that Tiptap editor only loads on pages that need it.
acceptance_criteria: No render-blocking resources flagged by Lighthouse
Font loading uses display=swap
Tiptap editor is not loaded on pages that don't use it
All key pages score 90+ on Performance

tasks.title: Verify all pages score 90+ after fixes
tasks.description: Re-run Lighthouse audits on all 5 key pages after applying accessibility and performance fixes. Confirm all categories score 90+. Document final scores alongside baselines.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 pages score 90+ on Performance
All 5 pages score 90+ on Accessibility
All 5 pages score 90+ on Best Practices
All 5 pages score 90+ on SEO
Final scores documented in docs/tasks/lighthouse-optimization.md

tasks.title: Add Lighthouse CI to GitHub Actions
tasks.description: Install @lhci/cli as a dev dependency. Create lighthouserc.js config with the URL list for all 5 key pages, score assertions at 90 threshold. Create .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml that runs on PR events, building the site and running Lighthouse CI against it.
acceptance_criteria: @lhci/cli installed as devDependency
lighthouserc.js config exists with URLs for all 5 key pages
Score assertions set to 90 for all categories
.github/workflows/lighthouse.yml runs on pull_request events
Workflow builds site before running Lighthouse

tasks.title: Configure Lighthouse CI PR comments and status checks
tasks.description: Configure Lighthouse CI to post score results as PR comments so reviewers can see performance impact. Add Lighthouse CI as a required status check for merge to prevent regressions below the 90 threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse CI posts score summary as PR comment
PRs are blocked from merging if any category drops below 90
Lighthouse status check appears in PR checks list
